canonical.title: All divisors of number
canonical.sourceFilePath: 06.Bit Manipulation/3. Advanced Maths/02. All divisors of number.cpp

narrative.title: Cutting the Cable Coil Into Every Equal Length
narrative.scenario: A cable crew must list every equal-length cut possible for a coil of length n, in ascending order. Scanning all lengths up to n wastes a shift; instead the crew checks lengths only up to the square root and records each complementary length — n divided by the small one — on a scratch list, then reads the scratch list backwards so the full catalogue ascends.
narrative.outputFormat: All divisors of n in ascending order.

complexity.optimalSpace: O(sqrt(n)) for the large-half scratch list

testCases.explanation: Small cuts 1, 2, 4 pair with large cuts 20, 10, 5; merged, the list ascends.
The square root 6 is a divisor exactly once — never list it twice.

hintLevels: Level 1: Divisors come in pairs (i, n / i) — checking one side finds both.
Level 2: Sweep i from 1 while i * i <= n; when i divides n, emit i and stash n / i unless it equals i.
Level 3: The stash fills in descending order, so a single reverse pass produces the ascending catalogue.
